# On and off by default — the `data` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#data).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** a JSON, YAML, TOML or Markdown file.
- **Rules:** 50 — 0 on, 28 on with `preview = true`, 18 off in an opt-in preset, 4 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `data/recommended` | yes, once the pack is installed | 6 | 4 error, 2 warn | Correctness for JSON, YAML and TOML: keys defined twice, aliases without an anchor, and the scalars YAML 1.1 and 1.2 read differently |
| `md/recommended` | when the repo has Markdown | 22 | 6 error, 16 warn | The non-layout rules of markdownlint 0.42.0's default set, reimplemented, with MD026, MD028, MD043, MD044 and MD054 (W-139) (layout belongs to the formatter), and the starter rule md/relative-links |
| `data/package-json` | no — opt in | 4 | 1 error, 3 warn | Starter rules for package.json |
| `data/tsconfig` | no — opt in | 2 | 1 error, 1 warn | Starter rules for tsconfig.json |
| `data/pyproject` | no — opt in | 3 | 1 error, 2 warn | Starter rules for pyproject.toml |
| `data/github-actions` | no — opt in | 3 | 2 error, 1 warn | Starter rules for GitHub Actions workflows and composite actions |
| `data/conventions` | no — opt in | 2 | 2 warn | Opt-in house conventions for YAML and Markdown |
| `data/markers` | no — opt in | 3 | 3 error | TODO comments with a ticket (and a date when asked) in YAML, TOML and Markdown |
| `data/codeowners` | no — opt in | 1 | 1 warn | CODEOWNERS coverage: every file has an owner, every pattern is live |

## Rules
